verdict.rationale: Bolna documents batches as a first-party object managed through its CLI, and multi-step outbound outreach sequences with waits and retries. That covers the core of batch outbound campaigns. Scheduling and throughput controls are not documented: waits and retries are not a campaign schedule, and the "thousands of calls every minute" line is a marketing scale claim, not a user-facing concurrency or rate control. Missing for 10: documented batch campaign scheduling (start times, recurring schedules or calling windows), explicit throughput/concurrency limits, batch API detail, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run batch outbound call campaigns with scheduling and throughput controls
